Senator Bernie Sanders is proposing an AI Sovereign Wealth Fund and a data center moratorium to ensure technology benefits the public, not just oligarchs.

The Poison:
Aggressive moratoriums on data centers could slow down technological innovation and infrastructure development.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
No major plane error. The narrative honestly connects the WHO (billionaires) with the WHAT (AI regulation) and WHY (democratic protection).

This approach seeks to empower the public by creating transparent, shared ownership structures, reducing systemic friction between tech elites and citizens.

The Trajectory: Stasis.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Good. The policy matches the rhetoric.

The Unavoidable Truth: AI wealth is highly concentrated.

The Unavoidable Lie: Unregulated tech markets naturally benefit everyone.

Sanders' proposal is structurally consistent with his established political framework, targeting systemic wealth inequality directly.
